definitions: To add unnecessary ornamentation or details to something that is already complete, beautiful, or perfect.
To attempt to improve something that is already satisfactory or excellent, often with the result of spoiling it.
examples: Her performance was flawless; trying to add more special effects would just be gilding the lily.
The original design was elegant and simple; the new additions are just gilding the lily.
Don't gild the lily; your essay is strong enough as it is.
